plan: final pipeline-correctness check on the organisers' public 5-minute window (PASS/FAIL only)
basis: organiser RULES.md (lines 77-80): the published 5 minutes are for checking that the pipeline is correct - frames aligned, file well-formed, labels meaning what you think; not training data and not a tuning set
organiser EVALUATION.md (lines 139-141): never to choose between two versions of the pipeline
team condition recorded in possession-v2-plan.json: public window only as a final run check after the pipeline is frozen
AGENTS.md: do not start another selection cycle from that check

tool.scorer: possession/official_metrics.py (the organisers' possession_metrics.py with a three-line header)

checks.valid_submission: organisers' validate_submission against the public ground-truth length
checks.teams_not_exchanged: spell_f1_mean and macro_f1 of the file are not lower than those of the same file with H and A exchanged

why_these_thresholds: They separate a broken pipeline from a working one and say nothing about quality: the organisers' scorer gives a perfect prediction with exchanged teams spell_f1 0.00 and macro_f1 about 0.33, and the trivial published baselines score 0.33-0.42 spell_f1 on this window. No external or provided-match result was used to set them.
output: PASS or FAIL per check; no score is printed or stored; the verdict of a (file, ground truth) pair is computed once and stored next to the file
when: after the release is frozen, on the file that is going to be submitted; run locally by the team
if_fail: look for a mapping or indexing bug (home/away assignment, frame offset, wrong input file). No model, threshold, decoder or release choice may be changed because of this check. A genuine pipeline bug is fixed in a new version with a synthetic regression test and is disclosed.
provided_fixture_used: only the organisers' public 5-minute ground truth and the team's own output file, locally
